description.p: depweave is a read-only dependency graph explorer for Arch Linux. It reads the local pacman database directly, draws the whole system as a zoomable graph, and answers the question "why is this package installed?" with every chain from an explicitly installed package.

ul.li: Fast graph view with focus mode, force-directed and layered layouts
"Why is this installed?" chains, orphan detection and removal impact
Never modifies the system and never needs root
